summary: Iteration 21 - Lot 5 Features Backend Testing Complete. All 30/30 tests PASSED. Likes, Analytics, Push VAPID, Content Scheduling, External URL all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND: POST /api/content/{id}/like - VERIFIED: Returns {ok:true, is_liked:true, likes_count:N}, idempotent (second POST doesn't double count)
BACKEND: DELETE /api/content/{id}/like - VERIFIED: Decrements likes_count, never goes below 0, returns {ok:true, is_liked:false, likes_count:N}
BACKEND: GET /api/feed - VERIFIED: Returns is_liked (bool) and likes_count (int) for each item
BACKEND: GET /api/creators/{id} - VERIFIED: Content array includes is_liked and likes_count fields
BACKEND: POST /api/creators/me/content - VERIFIED: Accepts scheduled_at (ISO datetime) and expires_in_hours (int)
BACKEND: Content with future scheduled_at - VERIFIED: Does NOT appear in /api/feed for non-owner fans
BACKEND: Content with expires_in_hours=24 - VERIFIED: Gets expires_at datetime set correctly
BACKEND: DELETE /api/creators/me/content/{id} - VERIFIED: Returns {ok:true}, cascade deletes unlocks/likes. Returns 403/404 for non-owners

BACKEND: GET /api/creators/me/analytics?days=7 - VERIFIED: Returns all required keys (days, active_subscribers, total_likes, totals_coins, totals_eur, earnings_timeline, subscribers_timeline, top_posts)
BACKEND: Analytics earnings_timeline - VERIFIED: Length equals days parameter, each item has {day, coins, tip_earn, unlock_earn, subscription_earn, live_ppv_earn, custom_request_earn}
BACKEND: Analytics subscribers_timeline - VERIFIED: Length equals days parameter
BACKEND: Analytics top_posts - VERIFIED: Max 5 items
BACKEND: PATCH /api/creators/me - VERIFIED: Accepts external_url field and persists it
BACKEND: GET /api/creators/{id} - VERIFIED: Returns external_url field
BACKEND: GET /api/push/vapid-public-key - VERIFIED: Returns {public_key, enabled:true}, public_key is valid base64url ~87 chars
BACKEND: POST /api/push/subscribe - VERIFIED: Returns {ok:true} with valid {endpoint, keys:{p256dh, auth}}, idempotent
BACKEND: POST /api/push/subscribe invalid - VERIFIED: Returns 400 for missing keys
BACKEND: POST /api/push/unsubscribe - VERIFIED: Returns {ok:true}, deletes specific endpoint subscription
REGRESSION: /api/media-file/{id} - VERIFIED: Endpoint exists (404 for invalid id)
REGRESSION: /api/media/{id} legacy - VERIFIED: Endpoint exists
REGRESSION: POST /api/media/wm-url - VERIFIED: Returns {path, expires_in} with signed watermark URL
REGRESSION: POST /api/wallet/cards/setup-intent - VERIFIED: Returns seti_*/cus_* (Stripe SetupIntent working)
